rubric.description: (a) Compares each student's grade (using `getGrade`) with `threshold` correctly (at least)
(a) Adds each qualifying student's name (using `getName`) and returns the list without modifying `students`
(b) Traverses `students` in a way that does not skip elements after a removal (for example from the end, or adjusting the index)
(b) Removes each student whose grade is less than `cutoff`
(b) Counts and returns the number of students removed
(a) Updates the quantity of the matching item and stops without adding a new item
(a) Adds a new `Item` to the end of the list only when no item has that name
(b) Traverses `items` without skipping elements after a removal
(b) Removes each item whose quantity is 0 and keeps the others in order
(b) Counts and returns the number of items removed
